title: Vhong Navarro studying options after Deniece Cornejo, Cedric Lee's release order
summary: Vhong Navarro’s legal counsel said the actor-host’s camp is still studying its legal options following the Court of Appeals’ order for the immediate release of Deniece Cornejo, Cedric Lee, and their…

blocks.text: Vhong Navarro’s legal counsel said the actor-host’s camp is still studying its legal options following the Court of Appeals’ order for the immediate release of Deniece Cornejo, Cedric Lee, and their two co-accused in connection with Navarro’s 2014 detention case. Atty. Alma Malonga said Navarro will continue to pursue remedies available under the law, while declining to elaborate on the specific actions his camp may take next. “We had already issued a statement. Let’s wait for what happens next. In truth, we are still carefully studying legal options,” Malonga told Inquirer Entertainment via text message on night of Sept. 28. In […]...
